title: PostgreSQL Advisory Locks for Queue Worker Deadlock Prevention
realWorldScenario: A multi-node payment capture service processes refunds. When a refund arrives, it must lock the customer record to update their ledger balance. Two concurrent refund requests for the same customer deadlock against each other because each transaction locks `payments` first, then attempts to lock `customers`.
questionStatement: Implement a distributed mutual-exclusion lock using PostgreSQL 64-bit transaction advisory locks (`pg_advisory_xact_lock`) against the customer ID before acquiring row locks. Explain why this completely eliminates deadlocks, and write the query acquiring the lock and executing the ledger deduction.
expectedConcepts: Deadlock root cause: non-deterministic lock acquisition order across tables
pg_advisory_xact_lock establishing mutual exclusion before table access
Serialization of concurrent customer operations in shared memory
Automatic lock release at COMMIT/ROLLBACK boundary
hints: By acquiring the advisory lock first, any concurrent transaction for the same customer waits before touching tables.
Transaction-level locks release on COMMIT or ROLLBACK automatically.
